newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sees second voucher sell-off tender March.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sees second voucher sell-off tender March.

text.p: Bulgaria could announce a second tender under its voucher privatisation programme by mid-March, Yosif Iliev, chairman of Bulgaria's Tender Committee, said on Wednesday.
"The tender might be announced in the first half of March," he told a news conference.

Iliev also said that share prices might fall at the second tender because vouchers worth 24-25 billion levs now stood against assets of some 50-52 billion levs after the first tender held at the end of last year.
Privatisation funds and individuals acquired equity with a par value of 32.4 billion levs in 968 companies with total assets of some 80 billion levs offered at the first tender.
Equity ranging between 25 percent and 90 percent in 341 firms out of the 968 was sold out.
A total of 1050 firms were earmarked for voucher privatisation under the government's sell-off programme expected to be carried out in three tenders. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
